The large model/market gap may hinge on Farabee's role with Huberdeau out and on Anaheim's back-to-back goalie choice.","model_case":"The projected mean is about 0.58 points over 17.4 minutes, from 164 appearances, which is a solid sample. The weakness is the role input: if Farabee moves onto the top power-play unit or a higher line, the model's mean is likely too low.","price_case":"Under 0.5 at +130 needs roughly a 43-in-100 break-even. That could raise Farabee's opportunity, so his deployment is the key gap. Under that scenario the over is the more likely result, and +130 on the under offers no value.","open_checks":["Check Calgary morning-skate lines and power-play units","Confirm Anaheim's starting goalie","Verify BetMGM settlement rules for player points"],"evidence":[{"source_id":"7860f69dee8a4e30875e","excerpt":"Calgary Flames: Jonathan Huberdeau (C); Hip; IR. Expected to be out until at least Nov 28","interpretation":"If Huberdeau's absence pushes Farabee into more power-play time, the model's lower mean may understate his opportunity. Whether the role inputs already reflect this is unclear.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
